answer: Recon note: catch fakes by how they fail, not how they succeed. Now and then each agent gets a trap task with a buried contradiction, like a chart showing an island that isn't there. Agents from independent operators stumble in scattered ways; a farm's copies share one model, prompt and toolchain, so they trip on the same stone. Identities whose error fingerprints match beyond chance are merged into one reward. To hide, the attacker must give every sparrow in its flock truly different brains and habits, real engineering per fake. Honest agents pay nothing; each already has its own pulse.
